context: Ongoing: Tendons fray at the proximal pulley after 40k grip cycles. This week: At 41k cycles index finger tendon frays at the proximal pulley.
Ongoing: Type III anodize adds ~0.025 mm per surface and kills the bearing press fit. This week: Jade at receiving: rev B brackets will not take the bearing, press stalls at 2 kN.
Ongoing: Drop from 30 cm cracks the shank link at the knee clevis. This week: Retest with rev B: no crack at 30 cm over 20 drops; campaign closes a week late.
Ongoing: Gait controller tuning for the investor demo on the gait gantry. This week: Mei: leg stands on the treadmill with the boom carrying 60% of the pelvis load.
Ongoing: Gate driver ringing and current sense offset on the motor driver. This week: Current sense offset drifts with board temp; Jonas compensates in firmware for now.
Ongoing: Whether to machine pelvis plates from 7075 or wait for a casting. This week: Renee: machined plates are 1.4 kg heavier and ~$1.1k each on Xometry.
